text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear anti-driverless position in opening and throughout","quality":"thesis focus","description":"The essay states a direct claim early and keeps returning to the same position instead of wavering."},{"evidence":"“First of all… Second… they also…”","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a simple but effective structure that sequences its reasons in an easy-to-follow order."},{"evidence":"Cost, still need a driver, court liability","quality":"development of reasons","description":"The essay gives multiple distinct arguments against driverless cars and explains each one enough to support the claim."},{"evidence":"“Needing a human driver at all defeats the purpose”","quality":"reasoned commentary","description":"The essay does more than quote the source by interpreting what the evidence means for its argument."},{"evidence":"“not very practical” and repeated summary at the end","quality":"concluding emphasis","description":"The ending reinforces the main argument by restating the key objections in a compact final judgment."}]}
